moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Festival Fringe, begins its three-week run tomorrow, bringing thousands of shows to the Scottish capital.

angles.name: Festival Buzz
angles.copy: Edinburgh is about to explode with creativity! The Fringe Festival officially starts tomorrow – who's heading up for the world's biggest arts event?

angles.name: Scottish Spotlight
angles.copy: Our capital city is gearing up for three weeks of incredible talent! The Edinburgh Fringe Festival begins its takeover tomorrow. What shows are you most excited for?

moments.title: Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo Begins
moments.blurb: The iconic Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo returns tomorrow, featuring massed pipes and drums, military bands, and cultural displays against the backdrop of Edinburgh Castle.

angles.name: Spectacle Begins
angles.copy: The pipes and drums are ready! The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo kicks off tomorrow, bringing its breathtaking spectacle to Edinburgh Castle. An absolute must-see!

angles.name: Iconic Scottish Event
angles.copy: One of Scotland's most iconic events starts tomorrow! The Royal Edinburgh Military Tattoo will once again light up Edinburgh Castle. Pure magic!

moments.title: The Edge (U2) turns 65
moments.blurb: David Evans, known as The Edge, the legendary guitarist of U2, celebrates his 65th birthday on Saturday.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 65th birthday to the one and only Edge from U2! His iconic guitar work has shaped generations of rock music. What's your favourite U2 riff?

angles.name: Celebrating The Edge
angles.copy: 65 years young for U2's incredible guitarist, The Edge, on Saturday! From 'With Or Without You' to 'Where The Streets Have No Name', his sound is unmistakable.

moments.title: Shawn Mendes turns 28
moments.blurb: Canadian pop superstar Shawn Mendes celebrates his 28th birthday on Saturday.

angles.name: Pop Heartthrob
angles.copy: Sending big birthday wishes to Shawn Mendes, who turns 28 on Saturday! What's your favourite track from the 'Stitches' singer?

angles.name: Celebrating Shawn
angles.copy: It's Shawn Mendes's 28th birthday on Saturday! The Canadian pop sensation has given us so many hits. Which one is on repeat for you?

moments.title: JC Chasez ('N Sync) turns 50
moments.blurb: Former *N Sync member and pop vocalist JC Chasez celebrates his 50th birthday on Saturday.

angles.name: Boy Band Icon
angles.copy: Happy 50th birthday to JC Chasez from *N Sync! Still tearing up our hearts with those classic boy band anthems. What's your favourite *N Sync track?

angles.name: Celebrating JC
angles.copy: It's a big 5-0 for JC Chasez this Saturday! The former *N Sync star helped define pop music in the late 90s and early 00s.

moments.title: Ian Anderson (Jethro Tull) turns 79
moments.blurb: Ian Anderson, the iconic flautist and frontman of progressive rock band Jethro Tull, celebrates his 79th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Prog Rock Legend
angles.copy: Happy 79th Birthday to the legendary Ian Anderson of Jethro Tull on Monday! Who else thinks his flute solos are absolutely iconic?

angles.name: Celebrating Jethro Tull
angles.copy: Monday marks Ian Anderson's 79th birthday! The Jethro Tull frontman brought the flute to the forefront of rock music. What's your favourite Tull track?

moments.title: Patti Austin turns 78
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning R&B and jazz singer Patti Austin celebrates her 78th birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Jazz & R&B Queen
angles.copy: Happy 78th birthday to the incredible Patti Austin on Monday! Her smooth vocals have graced so many classics. What's your top Patti Austin song?

angles.name: Celebrating Patti
angles.copy: Monday is Patti Austin's 78th birthday! A true powerhouse of R&B and jazz. Let's celebrate her amazing career!

moments.title: Neneh Cherry turns 62
moments.blurb: Swedish singer-songwriter and rapper Neneh Cherry, known for hits like 'Buffalo Stance', celebrates her 62nd birthday on Monday.

angles.name: Genre-Bending Icon
angles.copy: Happy 62nd birthday to the incomparable Neneh Cherry on Monday! A true pioneer blending pop, hip-hop, and dance. 'Buffalo Stance' still goes hard!

angles.name: Celebrating Neneh
angles.copy: It's Neneh Cherry's 62nd birthday on Monday! From her debut to her latest work, she's always pushed boundaries. What's your favourite Neneh track?

moments.title: Community Shield: Arsenal vs Man City
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield will take place on Sunday, August 16, at Principality Stadium in Cardiff, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal against FA Cup winners Manchester City.

angles.name: Football Curtain-Raiser
angles.copy: The football season curtain-raiser is just over a week away! Arsenal take on Man City in the Community Shield in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Big Game
angles.copy: Principality Stadium, Cardiff, is hosting a huge game next Sunday! Arsenal vs Manchester City in the Community Shield. Who's excited for the return of top-flight football?

moments.title: All Points East Festival Line-up Buzz
moments.blurb: London's All Points East Festival, running August 21-30, continues to generate buzz with its announced headliners including Tyler, The Creator, Lorde, and Twenty One Pilots.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is on for All Points East! With headliners like Tyler, The Creator and Lorde, it's set to be massive in London's Victoria Park from August 21. Who's got tickets?

angles.name: London's Big Festival
angles.copy: All Points East is just around the corner! Victoria Park will be buzzing with incredible acts like Twenty One Pilots and Deftones starting August 21. Get ready, London!

moments.title: Feargal Sharkey (The Undertones) turns 68
moments.blurb: Feargal Sharkey, lead singer of punk rock band The Undertones and later a successful solo artist, celebrates his 68th birthday on Thursday, August 13th.

angles.name: Teenage Kicks Legend
angles.copy: Happy 68th Birthday to Feargal Sharkey this Thursday! From The Undertones' 'Teenage Kicks' to his solo success, a truly distinctive voice.

angles.name: Celebrating Feargal
angles.copy: Thursday is Feargal Sharkey's 68th birthday! Remember 'A Good Heart'? A pop and punk icon.

moments.title: James Morrison turns 42
moments.blurb: English singer-songwriter James Morrison, known for his soulful voice and hits like 'You Give Me Something', celebrates his 42nd birthday on Thursday, August 13th.

angles.name: Soulful Singer
angles.copy: Happy 42nd Birthday to the brilliant James Morrison this Thursday! His soulful tunes always hit different. What's your favourite of his songs?

angles.name: Celebrating James
angles.copy: Thursday marks James Morrison's 42nd birthday! Time to put on 'You Give Me Something' and celebrate the incredible singer-songwriter.

moments.title: Sarah Brightman turns 66
moments.blurb: World-renowned soprano and actress Sarah Brightman, known for her work in musical theatre and classical crossover, celebrates her 66th birthday on Friday, August 14th.

angles.name: Voice of an Angel
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to the magnificent Sarah Brightman this Friday! Her voice is truly out of this world. What's your favourite performance of hers?

angles.name: Celebrating Sarah
angles.copy: Friday is Sarah Brightman's 66th birthday! The global star has captivated audiences around the world. Let's celebrate her incredible career!

moments.title: Larry Graham (Sly & The Family Stone) turns 80
moments.blurb: Funk pioneer and bassist Larry Graham, best known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone and as a solo artist with Graham Central Station, celebrates his 80th birthday on Friday, August 14th.

angles.name: Funk Bass Innovator
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday to the legendary Larry Graham this Friday! His groundbreaking bass techniques with Sly and the Family Stone changed funk music forever. What's your favourite groove?

angles.name: Celebrating Larry
angles.copy: Friday marks Larry Graham's 80th birthday! A true icon of funk and soul. Time to crank up some Graham Central Station!

moments.title: Commonwealth Games Glasgow Wrap-up
moments.blurb: The 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow concluded just a few days ago on August 2nd, with Scotland hosting a successful multi-sport event.

angles.name: Games Legacy
angles.copy: What an incredible Commonwealth Games it was in Glasgow! The action wrapped up on Sunday, but the memories and sporting achievements will last. What was your highlight?

angles.name: Scotland Shines
angles.copy: Glasgow truly shone as the host of the Commonwealth Games! The city delivered a fantastic event, concluding on Sunday. What a moment for Scotland!
